title: Quantum Substrate Model: Regime Structure and Dimensional Organization
description: This publication presents the Quantum Substrate Model (QSM), a structural framework for organizing multiple substrate regimes under explicitly declared boundaries, dimensional descriptors, and operator-mediated interactions. Extending minimal substrate modeling principles, the QSM formalizes how regimes may coexist, transition, or exit without embedding empirical claims, physical interpretation, or domain-specific semantics. The model is architecture-agnostic and intended to support clarity, interpretability, and reproducibility in layered systems.
